name: Anomaly Detection (Isolation Forest, LOF, One-Class SVM)
when_to_use: Identify rare/atypical cases with no (or few) labeled examples of anomalies; learns the "normal" pattern of the data and flags what deviates.
notes: Learns the "normal" pattern of the data and flags the cases that deviate too much from it. Applications: transaction fraud, sensor failure, audit outliers.

expected_input.question: Which cases deviate too much from the normal pattern of the data?

plain_explanation.purpose: Flags cases very different from the pattern that deserve attention.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When looking for fraud, errors or rare failures.
plain_explanation.data_needed: Numeric table, one case per row, in reasonable volume.
plain_explanation.example: Find out-of-pattern expenses in a spending dataset.
plain_explanation.diagram: cloud of normal points + a few isolated points = anomalies
